blocks.text: F2FS profiles target flash storage such as eMMC. The installer chooses the filesystem and mount policy. Btrfs subvolume and snapshot commands do not apply to F2FS.

Use the existing storage overview to identify pressure before deleting files. Close applications and back up user data before cleanup. Flash wear and power loss can affect reliability; keep external copies of irreplaceable files.

For suspected corruption stop unnecessary writes, preserve evidence, and arrange an administrator-led offline repair plan. Never run filesystem repair on a mounted filesystem or format a device as a troubleshooting step.
